provenance: config/supervisor/supervisord.conf explicitly binds the evidence_writer EVIDENCE_DATABASE_PATH to database/evidence_platform/production/evidence.db under the repository root.
src/evidence/config.py consumes EVIDENCE_DATABASE_PATH as the evidence database path; its non-production fallback is database/evidence_platform/evidence.db, never database/evidence.db.
Committed evidence-platform audit and migration artifacts identify database/evidence_platform/production/evidence.db as the production evidence database.

The PSI0A capture manifest and C16 boundary preserve the logical source and filename but intentionally do not encode a host path, so their evidence.db filename cannot be interpreted as repository database/evidence.db.

absent_assumed_path.explanation: No committed runtime configuration or reader/writer path contract places the production evidence database directly under database/. The failed D2 preflight incorrectly prepended database/ to a filename-only manifest field and omitted the configured evidence_platform/production directory.

root_cause: D2 caller treated the capture manifest's filename-only evidence source identity as though it implied database/evidence.db, despite the committed production binding to database/evidence_platform/production/evidence.db.
smallest_repair: Correct the caller-supplied evidence source path and bind its path digest in the next D2 authorization/input fingerprint. No capture-input manifest or query-contract amendment is required.
